projects.notes: Existing draft description edited under lmdanavanem; all 357 original criteria characters preserved after the published evidence prefix. Exact 2763-character Markdown readback verified after server reload. Done status verified after a separate server reload. No issue or conversation comment was created. All three saved filters retained, with no unsaved view changes. Suggestions was left open as the deliverable and the temporary viewport override was reset.

limits: Top-level page-content objects only; annotation/widget overlays and inner Form objects are separate.
Drawing order changes intended overlap visibility; geometry, styles, content and original relative order remain attached to moved objects.
A completed drag uses one existing worker transaction; headless EN/FR pointer and Escape checks are not native/manual accessibility qualification.
Existing digital signatures can be invalidated by content edits; save a separate copy.
Windows packages are unsigned; no independent publication key is available. Update authenticity depends on GitHub HTTPS and same-channel SHA256.
ARM64 hardware, physical printers/GPU, Narrator, interactive installation/update flows and independent reader interoperability remain separate qualification.
No PDF/A/PDF/UA or archival LTV certification.
delivery: Authorized owner pushes used the existing branch/tag-rule bypass; no rules were changed. A draft-only tag was corrected before any release assets/publication to add the page-object cache guard. Final main/tag CI qualify the same immutable published source; the post-publication commit contains documentation only.
